content_sections.heading: AADHAAR Supervisor/Operator Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the following eligibility conditions to apply for the Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator - District post: Minimum age: 18 years or above The maximum age limit is not specified in the official job posting. Candidates must meet any one of the following qualification combinations: 12th (Intermediate/Senior Secondary) pass, OR Matriculation + 2 Years ITI, OR Matriculation + 3 Years Polytechnic Diploma Candidates must hold an Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate issued by a Testing & Certifying Agency authorised by UIDAI for delivering Aadhaar services. Candidates should have basic computer skills. VLEs (Village Level Entrepreneurs) are not eligible to apply for this position. Candidates holding a 12th pass or ITI/Polytechnic qualification can also explore more 12th Pass Government Jobs and ITI Government Jobs available across India

content_sections.heading: AADHAAR Operator/Supervisor Certification Process
content_sections.text: Candidates who do not already hold the mandatory Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate can complete the process as follows: Take the Aadhaar Supervisor exam through the official link: UIDAI Aadhaar Supervisor Exam Portal Once the exam is applied for, an authorisation request is sent to the respective State Team. After the State Team approves the request, the candidate becomes eligible to appear for the Aadhaar Supervisor exam. The Aadhaar LMS Certification can be taken once the candidate's LMS ID and Password are created and approved. After approval, candidates can appear for the LMS Certification through: UIDAI e-Learning Portal

content_sections.heading: AADHAAR Supervisor/Operator Recruitment 2026 Salary Structure
content_sections.text: The remuneration for the Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator - District post is as per the minimum wages of the respective state set for semi-skilled manpower. The exact monthly pay figure is not specified in the official job posting, as it will vary according to Rajasthan's applicable minimum wage rate for semi-skilled workers.

content_sections.heading: AADHAAR Supervisor/Operator Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: A detailed, separate selection process (such as a written exam or interview) has not been specified in the official job posting. Based on the available information, the key requirement is that candidates already possess a valid Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate issued by a UIDAI-authorised testing and certifying agency at the time of application. Candidates who do not yet hold this certificate can obtain it through the Aadhaar Supervisor exam and Aadhaar LMS Certification process described above.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for AADHAAR Supervisor/Operator Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The official job posting does not list specific documents required at the time of application. Candidates are generally advised to keep the following ready, subject to confirmation from the official portal: Educational qualification certificates (12th/Matriculation + ITI/Polytechnic Diploma, as applicable) Valid Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate Age proof Identity proof Recent passport-size photograph

content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply for the Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator - District post by following these steps: Visit the official CSC job portal at career.csccloud.in.
